trn.review: She will take 3 assignments and 5 quizzes (3 will be counted) and a multi-draft essay. She's 100% fair with grading and also curves. There will be a lot of group projects in class, so do them properly. It doesn't matter if you answer questions in class or not because she notices everyone. All that matters is being attentive and showing up. She's eventually very generous with marking. For essays 60% of the marks will be based on structure. Follow her structure, do not miss quizzes or assignments, and definitely not the multi-draft.
